name: When do I need to hire a general contractor instead of a handyman?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to hire a general contractor instead of a handyman?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need a general contractor when a home improvement project involves multiple specialized trades, structural alterations, or municipal permits. Simple tasks like repainting a bedroom or replacing a faucet can be handled by a handyman or specialty installer. However, full-scope projects such as kitchen remodels, basement finishes, or room additions require coordinating framing, drywall, electrical work, plumbing, and finish surfaces. Hiring a general contractor provides a single point of contact to schedule sub-trades, manage quality control, and keep finish carpentry, tile, and painting aligned with building codes and design plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for multi-trade remodels, additions, or structural changes requiring permits. Use a handyman for single, minor repairs or simple maintenance.
